answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 7434 Country: India Title: CAN MARRAIGE TAKE PLACE IN THE MONTH OF RAMADHAN ANY RESTRICTIONS? Question: CAN MARRAIGE TAKE PLACE IN THE MONTH OF RAMADHAN ANY RESTRICTIONS? Answer ID: 7434 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1489/1404=D/1429) It can be, there is no prohibition, but doing intercourse while fasting in daytime is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
